planets.name: WASP-103 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-103 with a 0.926-day year, found in 2014.

text.card: WASP-103 b was found in 2014 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-103. Its orbit and size follow Gillon et al. 2014's fit, the archive's default.
